b'# tinydl

A small command-line tool for downloading files from URLs.

## Usage

```
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## Command line options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o, --output <file>` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q, --quiet` | no progress output |

## Example

```bash
# Download to stdout (piped to a file)
tinydl https://example.com/file.json | jq .

# Download to a file
tinydl https://example.com/file.json -o file.json
```

## Install

```bash
pip install -e .
```

Then run with `tinydl`.
'
